title: Section gating and onboarding checks
description:
Goal
- Restrict access to Journal and Goals until onboarding is complete.

Onboarding completion rule
- getCurrentMacroGoal returns a current macro goal AND listMicroGoalsForMacro for that macro includes at least one micro goal.

UI behavior
- Navigation shows Chat, Journal, Goals; Journal and Goals are disabled or hidden until onboarding completes.
- Once onboarding completes, nav updates dynamically to enable Journal and Goals without a full reload.

Tech notes
- Implement a lightweight onboardingStatus hook or server action that calls the two endpoints and caches with React Query.
- Guard routes (middleware or client-side guards) and reflect state in the nav.
- Consider a loading indicator while status is being determined.

Acceptance criteria
- Before completion: only Chat is accessible; Journal and Goals are disabled or guarded.
- After completion: Journal and Goals become accessible and usable immediately.
- Errors and loading states are handled and visible to the user.

features.title: Navigation shell
features.description: Implement top or side navigation with items: Chat, Journal, Goals. Reflect gated state visually (disabled style or tooltip) when onboarding is incomplete. Use shadcn/ui components for consistent styling. Acceptance: only Chat is enabled before onboarding complete; others are visibly gated.

features.title: Onboarding status hook
features.description: Create a React Query hook that calls 'getCurrentMacroGoal' and, if present, 'listMicroGoalsForMacro' to compute onboarding status: 'complete' if macro goal exists and micro goals list has at least one item, else 'incomplete'. Cache result and refetch on window focus. Return loading/error state.

features.title: Route guards
features.description: Guard '/journal' and '/goals' routes. If onboarding is incomplete, redirect to '/chat' (client-side for MVP; can move to middleware/server action later). Update nav interactivity based on the hook result. Acceptance: direct navigation to gated routes before completion redirects to '/chat'.

features.title: Loading and error states
features.description: Show a lightweight skeleton/spinner while onboarding status is loading. If an error occurs, display an inline error with a retry button that refetches the status. Acceptance: states transition cleanly without layout shift.
